title: Consumer Mediation Cell Must Maintain a List of Empanelled Mediators

content.scenario: A Consumer Mediation Cell has been established in a district to resolve consumer disputes. The cell needs to maintain certain information as per the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
content.outcome: The Consumer Mediation Cell must maintain a list of empanelled mediators, a list of cases handled by the cell, a record of proceedings, and any other information as may be specified by regulations.

user_queries: What information must a Consumer Mediation Cell maintain?
What is the purpose of maintaining a list of empanelled mediators?
Can a Consumer Mediation Cell maintain additional information beyond what is specified in the Act?
